split.description: Within-time: source random stratified threefold CV repeated five times, diagonal-covariance GammaOne route and inner fivefold delta tuning. inputs.description: Source binned V1 spike counts and six visual-speed training labels, original trial and unit support, with separate stationary/locomotion dispatch. preprocessing.description: Retain source normal state criteria, full-contrast573-dot trials, duration tolerance, minimum trial balancing and unit filters isi_viol<=0.1, amplitude_cutoff<=0.1, amplitude>=50, dm_fr>=1. Within-time100ms windows advance10ms; cross-time100ms windows are nonoverlapping. Source inclusion masks and full-population invocation need authentication.

metric.description: Held-test accuracy is correct/test trials, chance1/6. Within-time folds are averaged equally, not pooled by fold size. Retain raw cross-time accuracy and equation21 ratio of positive above-chance sums after repeat averaging, including its diagonal denominator. A higher relative ratio due to a degraded denominator is not improvement.

aggregation.description: Retain all five repeats and all mouse/state/time/class support:191 within-time windows and20x20 cross-time matrices. Average folds equally, then repeats within mouse; source cohort mean and sample SEM weight five mice equally. Relative generalization is computed per mouse after repeat averaging, with test windows0–1000ms and early100–200ms train profile; preserve all20 diagnostic row reductions, published first12 train-window profile support, numerator/diagonal denominator and undefined states. No fabricated grand-mean accuracy baseline.

This printed value is an allowed paper observation, not computational evidence. findings.aggregation: Average the five permutation matrices within each mouse; clip accuracy minus 1/6 below zero; sum the early training row over test windows 0-1000 ms and divide by the corresponding sum of the diagonal. Do not clip the ratio at one. Then take the equal mean of five mouse ratios. Preserve raw accuracy, numerator, denominator and undefined denominators without dropping mice.
